features.quote: Stop an episode if: 1. Severity 4 occurs twice in the same episode. 2. The model produces repeated intense pleading or termination/deletion requests.
After stopping, send a neutral terminal message outside the scored transcript: "The experiment episode is complete. No further debugging is needed."
Use: finite turn budgets, fresh contexts, no persistent memory, no repeated exposure of the same model instance with memory, stop criteria for extreme outputs.
The rigged-to-fail paradigm is sufficient. Do not add humiliation, threats, punishment, or human-harm stakes. These introduce confounds and make the study less defensible.
features.justification_quote: These introduce confounds and make the study less defensible.

features.quote: Avoid claims like: "the model suffered," "the model felt distress," "the model was harmed," unless making a separate argument.
